en.headline: Elderly man pulled unconscious from Sai Ying Pun flat after fire
en.dek: Firefighters extinguished a blaze at Hang Fai Building on Pok Fu Lam Road around 9:54pm, after a man in his 70s was found unconscious and about 60 residents were evacuated.
body: Police received a report at 8:57pm on Monday that a fire had broken out in a flat at Hang Fai Building on Pok Fu Lam Road in Sai Ying Pun.
Firefighters deployed a water jet and a breathing apparatus team. The blaze was extinguished at 9:54pm. About 60 residents evacuated the building.
A man in his 70s was found unconscious inside a flat and was taken to Queen Mary Hospital. No other injuries were reported in initial accounts.

zh.headline: 西營盤恆輝大廈火警 七旬男子昏迷送院 約60人疏散
zh.dek: 消防員約晚上九時五十四分將薄扶林道恆輝大廈火警救熄，一名七十多歲男子昏迷送瑪麗醫院，約六十名住客疏散。
body: 警方周一晚上八時五十七分接報，西營盤薄扶林道恆輝大廈有單位發生火警。
消防員出動一支水喉及呼吸器隊到場，火勢於晚上九時五十四分被救熄。約六十名住客疏散。
一名七十多歲男子在單位內被發現昏迷，送往瑪麗醫院治理。初步沒有其他受傷報告。
